aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
display_name: Meesho implementation — Monthly Reverse Shipping Cost
filters: Use active-row and source-specified marketplace filters; scope fields remain columns/caveats only.
formula_text:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS returns,
  SUM(taxable_value) AS reverse_shipping_excl_gst,
  ROUND(SUM(taxable_value) * 1.18, 2) AS reverse_shipping_incl_gst
FROM zs_observe.meesho_other_charges_expenses
WHERE is_active = true
  AND LOWER(type) = 'reverse_shipping'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
